COUNTER-STRIKE 2 WEB 1:1

Three.js + TypeScript + Rapier 3D Fizikasi

Boshqaruv tugmalari (CS2 1:1):

  • W, A, S, D — Yugurish (Counter-strafing)
  • Space — Sakrash (Jump / Bunny Hop)
  • Ctrl — Cho'qqayish (Crouch)
  • Shift — Sekin yurish (Walk)
  • Sichqoncha Chap tugmasi — O't ochish (yoki teskari rejimda Zoom)
  • Sichqoncha O'ng tugmasi (yoki Z / V) — Barcha qurollarda YA Q I N L A S H T I R I S H (Zoom / ADS)
  • R — O'qni yangilash (Reload)
  • 1, 2, 3 — Qurollarni almashtirish (Asosiy, Pistol, Pichoq)
  • B — Qurollar do'koni (Buy Menu)
  • ESC — Menyuni ochish / qulflash

CS2 QUROLLAR DUKONI (BUY MENU)

Yopish uchun yana 'B' yoki 'ESC' tugmasini bosing
